name: Aval
description: Prove money is committed but not yet arrived, so a counterparty can act now instead of waiting for settlement. The amount never reaches the chain.
accentRationale: Two accents, semantic rather than decorative, because the split IS the product argument. #34d399 SIGNAL is what the counterparty learns; #56b6f0 LEDGER is what the public chain learns. A surface is tinted only when it belongs to one of those two audiences.
fontRationale: No web fonts and no network fetch at page load; the demo must render fully offline. Institutional finance / trading terminal: system sans for prose, true monospace with tabular figures for every value compared side by side.
shadowRationale: Depth is one-pixel borders and surface-elevation steps only. No box-shadow, no drop-shadow, no backdrop-blur ships in the build. Glow reads as marketing; this surface has to read as an instrument.
signatureElement: The split rule: a two-pixel cap in each pane's own accent, which side by side forms one continuous two-tone line across the page. The same motif is the logo — a filled block beside an open outline containing nothing.

motion.reducedMotion: all animation and transition collapsed to 0.01ms

logoVariants.selectionBasis: [AUTO] favicon legibility at 16px — the logomark is the only variant that stays readable; the wordmark loses its letterforms and the combination loses its text.

rejectionList: bounce or spring on functional controls
marketing copy in the product surface
any number the contract did not actually produce
